propositions: Core must compare only canonical (local-vocabulary) shapes; vendor shapes cross the core boundary solely as opaque payloads produced/consumed by port calls at emission and ingestion boundaries.
All 8 remaining Jira vendor modules (acli*, adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits) must be physically relocated into adapters/jira/ with loaders repointed and no re-export shims.
Package-root reconciler core modules must have zero vendor reach-through: no adapters.jira imports, no lazy-key literals, no by-path loads of vendor files, except the exempted inbound_fields.py.
The outbound and link differs must canonicalize snapshots via InboundMapper and build vendor payloads only via injected OutboundMapper at emission, achieving parity with the inbound differ pattern.

The scalar port surface must be extended with project/query_project, assert_env_ready, and a neutral BackendAssigneeNotFoundError, routing fetcher, applier, and apply_handlers through the backend interface.
